meta.title: Vriksha Strategy Manager Architecture
meta.subtitle: Local Python research factory for strategy profiles, market data, backtests, rebalances, exports, and admin dashboards.

nodes.label: CLI command router
nodes.tooltip: Central command surface for database setup, universe sync, Kite token flows, history fetches, backtests, finalized packages, model-portfolio updates, daily automation, reminders, and admin snapshot export.

nodes.label: Windows run scripts
nodes.tooltip: Convenience batch files invoke the CLI and Streamlit dashboards for manual, monthly, auto-daily, backtest, live, and reminder workflows.

nodes.label: Streamlit dashboards
nodes.tooltip: Backtest and live dashboards read SQLite; admin dashboard reads a safe JSON snapshot without secrets, holdings rows, broker data, or performance metrics.

nodes.label: .env and runtime config
nodes.tooltip: Loads provider settings, paths, strategy defaults, Kite credentials, Telegram flags, package metadata, and optimization paths from environment variables.

nodes.label: Strategy registry and profiles
nodes.tooltip: Authoritative list of four active profiles. Profiles carry identity, schedule, package paths, methodology paths, optimization settings, and fixed-allocation assets where applicable.

nodes.label: Profile applicator
nodes.tooltip: Loads a selected profile and applies package, benchmark, documentation, optimization, and schedule-derived fields into app.config before a run.

nodes.label: Registry validation
nodes.tooltip: Validates profile shape, slug uniqueness, objective values, doc paths, optimization paths/results, finalized config alignment, allocation weights, and package folder naming.

nodes.label: Universe workbook
nodes.tooltip: The real workbook is expected locally and is not committed; the repo includes an example workbook. Runtime sync fails honestly if the real source is absent.

nodes.label: Universe sync and loader
nodes.tooltip: Validates required symbol metadata, writes runtime Nifty 500 JSON plus validation report, and reloads stale JSON from Excel when needed.

nodes.label: Market data providers
nodes.tooltip: Kite is the default provider with instrument-token resolution, chunking, throttling, and retry handling. Yahoo Finance remains a configurable fallback.

nodes.label: Kite token workflow
nodes.tooltip: Manual and Selenium-assisted login exchange a request_token for a daily access token, save it to .env, and validate it with Kite profile().

nodes.label: Price ingestion
nodes.tooltip: Fetches daily prices for requested symbols, the benchmark, and safe assets; converts provider frames to PriceBar records; persists rows and ingestion audit metadata.

nodes.label: SQLite research store
nodes.tooltip: Local database holds runs, audit events, portfolio snapshots, holding snapshots, stock history table, order proposals, backtest runs, artifacts, market prices, and ingestion runs.

nodes.label: Repository functions
nodes.tooltip: Read/write API for strategy runs, backtest runs, snapshots, holdings, order proposals, audit events, and contribution summaries.

nodes.label: Ranking and allocation
nodes.tooltip: Backtest helper computes 3M/6M/12M momentum, 52-week-high qualification, beta, volatility, average-rank or weighted-score rankings; selection applies top-N, buffers, stock caps, sector caps, and safe-asset residual.

nodes.label: Dual-momentum backtest
nodes.tooltip: Runs finalized configurable-period dual-momentum simulations from stored prices and universe data, persists monthly portfolio and holding snapshots, and records run metrics/warnings.

nodes.label: Fixed-allocation backtest
nodes.tooltip: Runs quarterly fixed-weight multi-asset simulations using profile assets, price data, optional distribution events, and transaction-cost estimates.

nodes.label: Monthly rebalance engine
nodes.tooltip: Builds the current target portfolio from latest stored prices and profile parameters, persists snapshots, and creates proposed buy/sell orders scaled by available purchase funds.

nodes.label: Optimization adapter
nodes.tooltip: Loads profile-specific optimizer modules, binds active database/universe paths and search space, runs the Optuna grid, ranks results, and writes trial CSV output.

nodes.label: Finalized parameters
nodes.tooltip: Selects the best optimization row, writes a finalized parameter JSON, and applies those values into app.config before finalized backtests and rebalance runs.

nodes.label: Daily automation scheduler
nodes.tooltip: Computes monthly target days or quarterly first-trading-day dates with a provisional Monday-Friday calendar; NSE holiday support is explicitly deferred.

nodes.label: Telegram reminders
nodes.tooltip: Loads every profile schedule from the registry, emits due-today/due-tomorrow reminders, and sends them when Telegram is enabled and configured.

nodes.label: Strategy package builder
nodes.tooltip: Builds portable Vriksha package files from completed backtests: manifest, returns, drawdowns, benchmark, latest portfolio, histories, exposures, methodology, disclosures, and import notes.

nodes.label: Model portfolio update
nodes.tooltip: Exports the latest monthly holdings subset for subscriber model-portfolio updates after a successful rebalance.

nodes.label: Safe admin snapshot
nodes.tooltip: Generates data/admin/strategy_dashboard.json with catalogue, schedules, file existence, commands, and validation; deliberately excludes sensitive and performance data.

nodes.label: Package/output files
nodes.tooltip: Generated package, finalized config, optimization CSV, fixed-allocation summaries, model-update files, and admin snapshot live under data/output and data/admin.

nodes.label: Generic StrategyEngine
nodes.tooltip: Future canonical ranking/target-portfolio engine is documented but not implemented; current production logic lives in BacktestEngine and RebalanceEngine.

nodes.label: Live broker execution
nodes.tooltip: Broker protocol exists, but Zerodha holdings, order reads, live placement, and reconciliation raise NotImplementedError. The app creates order proposals only.

nodes.label: Portfolio history services
nodes.tooltip: PortfolioTracker and PortfolioHistoryService are placeholders; dashboards currently read snapshots and summaries directly from repository functions.

flows.name: Finalized Vriksha Package
flows.summary: Promote optimized parameters, ensure history, backtest, and export a full strategy package.
flows.description: The CLI applies a strategy profile, selects/writes finalized parameters from optimizer results, syncs universe and Kite/Yahoo price history when requested, runs the dual-momentum backtest, persists snapshots, and builds the portable Vriksha package files.

flows.name: Auto Daily Rebalance Check
flows.summary: Refresh token/data daily and rebalance only on profile schedule dates.
flows.description: The daily CLI workflow validates or refreshes the Kite token, syncs universe, fetches recent history, checks the profile schedule using the provisional weekday calendar, and runs RebalanceEngine on configured rebalance days.

flows.name: Latest Model Portfolio Update
flows.summary: Run the current rebalance path and export only subscriber update files.
flows.description: The CLI applies finalized profile config, refreshes recent history unless skipped, delegates target-portfolio generation to the monthly rebalance workflow, then exports latest portfolio, histories, and exposure CSVs.

flows.name: Fixed-Allocation Strategy
flows.summary: Use profile-defined assets, distributions, and quarterly rebalancing for the income strategy.
flows.description: The fixed-allocation command loads a strategy profile, reads stored prices and distribution events, simulates quarterly rebalances with transaction costs, persists snapshots, and can feed the normal package exporter.

flows.name: Admin Visibility
flows.summary: Generate a safe snapshot and view it in Streamlit without exposing sensitive data.
flows.description: The admin export validates the strategy registry, reads limited run/file status from storage, writes data/admin/strategy_dashboard.json, and the admin dashboard renders that snapshot only.

flows.name: Market Data Foundation
flows.summary: Turn the local universe and external provider data into normalized SQLite price rows.
flows.description: Universe sync validates Excel and writes runtime JSON; the selected provider fetches daily bars for active symbols, benchmark, and safe assets; ingestion normalizes rows and records both prices and ingestion-run metadata.

flows.name: Planned Live Execution
flows.summary: Order proposals exist; unattended live broker placement and reconciliation are intentionally not built.
flows.description: RebalanceEngine writes proposed orders, but broker placement, holdings retrieval, order reconciliation, and stock-history service layers are stubs. This is a future integration path, not a current production execution path.
